mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (user_id, order_item_id, product_id, sku_id, rating, content, images, is_anonymous) VALUES (#{userId}, #{orderItemId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images}, #{isAnonymous})
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET reply = #{reply} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM review WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE product_id = #{productId}
